worldcombat.skill.laserfocus.summary: Concentrate to make the next hit land as a critical hit; the honed edge stays until you strike, and fades on its own if you do not.
worldcombat.skill.laserfocus.use.0: Hone the edge before the foe commits to a big hit
worldcombat.skill.laserfocus.use.1: Turn a single key hit into a lethal one
worldcombat.skill.laserfocus.use.2: Force the foe to back off before the edge fades
worldcombat.skill.laserfocus.description: Windup %1$s, recovery %2$s. The edge is on yourself and needs no aim.
worldcombat.skill.laserfocus.steady.on: Steady focus: a longer edge window, but windup costs %1$s more and cooldown grows to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.laserfocus.steady.off: Quick hone: a shorter window and a shorter cooldown, good for honing every swing often.
worldcombat.skill.laserfocus.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.laserfocus.growth.0: Level %1$s: the edge window rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.laserfocus.growth.1: Level %1$s: the edge window rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.laserfocus.growth.2: Level %1$s: the edge window rises to %2$s.
On, the edge burns longer and brighter: window x1.6 and more light, but a longer windup and cooldown; off keeps the window and cooldown short for frequent honing.
The companion only hones while a threat is within this many blocks; smaller prepares at point-blank, larger prepares ahead of time.
When the threat is closer than this the companion stops honing and just attacks; larger gives up the buff more often in close combat.
When on, a Hold order does not stop the companion from honing first.
